reviews.title: Good PSU
reviews.comment: I've always had good luck with Cooler Master PSU's and this one continues to perform.  I installed this in a new Ryzen 7 build and it works great.  Ample cables that are long enough and have enough connectors for most purposes.  I have no complaints.
reviews.author: Bill

reviews.title: This power supply is a monster!!
reviews.comment: They had a prebuilt gaming PC that I bought from cyber power. After about five months of owning it, I went to start up one day, and I had zero power. There was no power to the motherboard, no lights would come on, no movement from any of the fans, nothing at all. I went ahead and ordered this power supply to replace the one that came with my PC. It was super easy to route the cables from the motherboard to the backside so that I could keep everything neat and tucked away. The best part about this power supply is that you only have to use the wires that you need, so you don’t have a giant bulk of wire with connections that you don’t even use. The power is super stable and it is powering not only my computer, but my monster GPU, which is an RTX 5060 TI I highly, highly recommend this product. Cooler master has been around for a long time, and I have no doubt in my mind that this thing will continue to power, my monster gaming rig without any issues whatsoever.
reviews.author: William

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.comment: Solid PSU, is very quiet and has great cable management since it is modular, got it at good price, and was an easy installation.
reviews.author: Jaedyn

reviews.title: Received open box with missing cables
reviews.comment: I was sent a clearly already opened box with half the cables missing.  And I see others in the reviews had a similar experience.  What a waste of time and energy just for me to have to return it immediately.
reviews.author: Mike

reviews.title: Quiet & Hard-working!
reviews.comment: So far, this PSU has not failed me. I’ve had it running for a little over a month, and I never hear it, which is a great sign from a power supply. The moment you start noticing your PSU, you are probably in trouble haha.
reviews.author: Christian Payne
